content:
General
* I'm not sure why you recreated your contribution when the task itself remains unchanged. It would be better to simply revise your original contribution. This way, the original comments are preserved, which could be important for reviewers if they need to refer to them. A new contribution should only be created when the original idea has been substantially abandoned.

Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format the statement properly by following the example there.

Syntax to use:
[[ ]] for variables (S in the Input section)
{{ }} for constants (0, 1, 111, # in the Goal, Input and Output sections)

Cases
* As each test and its corresponding validator cover the same scenario using slightly different inputs and outputs, please modify or add cases as follows:

  • Validator 4: Revise S so that it consists of six 0s or more, with no 1s.

  • Add Test 5 and Validator 5: Use 1 as the value of S in one case, and 11 in the other.

  • Add Test 6 and Validator 6: Use 0011100100 as the value of S in one case, and 0010011100 in the other.

  • Add Test 7 and Validator 7: Use 0111111110 as the value of S in one case, and 0111111100 in the other.

Thanks.

Constraints
* Please change 100 back to 10. There's no reason to increase the upper bound when [[S]] is never longer than 10 characters.

Cases
* Validator 4 is the same as Test 4. Please add more zeros to [[S]] in Validator 4.

Thanks.
